name: dot-loader
title: Dot Loader
description: Loading dots that hop in a wave, breathe in a pulse, or sit in a chat bubble as a typing indicator.

perf.budget: One repeating shared value drives every dot on the UI thread. It animates for as long as it is shown, so unmount it when loading ends.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest is the loader itself; unmount it when loading ends.

a11y.reducedMotion: The dots stay in place and only brighten one after another.
a11y.screenReader: One progress indicator named by accessibilityLabel (Loading by default), such as "The host is typing".

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { DotLoader } from '@/components/kinetik/dot-loader';

<DotLoader />
<DotLoader variant="pulse" color={theme.colors.azure} />
<DotLoader variant="typing" accessibilityLabel="Mara is typing" />
```

## When to use

- Short waits inside a piece of the screen: a button, a card, a reply on its way.
- Chat threads, with `variant="typing"`.

## When not to use

- Waits with a known length. Show progress.
- Loading a whole screen of content. Use Skeleton Sweep, which shows the shape of what is coming.

## Notes

- One shared value drives every dot on the UI thread; the JS thread is never involved.
- Each cycle ends with a short rest, so the rhythm reads as calm rather than busy.
- It keeps animating while mounted. Unmount it as soon as the wait is over.
- With reduced motion the dots stay put and brighten in turn.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add dot-loader`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
